$comment: Locked Keep the Line chrome. No STEADI, stand counts, or clinical labels.

howto.title: Keep the Line
howto.body: Match the ghost. Keep your knee over your foot as you stand and sit. When the line holds, you score a hit. If knees drift or hands push off, you get a miss on that joint. Stop is always on the screen. Your coach talks when you finish, not during.

ready.title: Before you start
ready.body: Sturdy chair behind you? Feeling OK to start?

frame.title: We need to see you
frame.body: Stand so your hips, knees, and feet are in the outline.

live.step_back: We could not see your knee clearly. Step back.
